name: Forged Lantern writ
description: A release writ under a Lantern Court seal in correct red wax. The crown is pressed to the left of the lamp. Mirela insists you found it on the road.
notes: mw-m97i: forged by Mirela (mirela-stacks forge-fx); Cray takes it and passes it unless the player already tried a bribe (then she catches it: the crown is on the wrong side of the lamp). Quest item: noSell, noDrop.
